text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down roughly 2% over 24 hours, suggesting a mild pullback from recent strength rather than capitulation. The Fear & Greed index at 66 (Greed) and up 32 points weekly signals sustained optimism despite the dip, with Bitcoin dominance holding steady at 59.2%—indicating traders aren't rotating heavily into alts. Volume at $94B remains solid, pointing to orderly selling pressure rather than panic liquidation.
